name: oruk
description: Transcribe prerecorded English speech and analyze vocal emotion, tone, and speaking style with Oruk.

interface.longDescription: Analyze prerecorded English speech from an audio URL or inline audio bytes. Get transcripts, emotion and speaking-style scores, and speaker turns when requested. Connect to Oruk's hosted MCP server without a local runtime. Discovery works without a key; speech analysis uses a configured API key or a limited temporary trial.
defaultPrompt: Use Oruk to transcribe https://oruk.ai/samples/oruk-quickstart.wav and describe the speaker's tone and speaking style. Use oruk-resonance and a temporary trial key if no API key is configured.
